system.longDesc: Your attack or maneuver ruptures the fuel line of an enemy vehicle, causing an explosion or burst of flame. This deals 3d6 penetrating damage to the operator and all passengers and has the effects of the Mobility Kill stunt as well. Vehicles without combustible elements suffer the effects of Mobility Kill but do not damage their occupants. In all cases, however, the vehicle is wrecked to the point where it can’t be repaired in the field.
